scope: MBO reconstruction, market replay, independently pluggable feature generation
route_selection: most frequent instrument in initial 500000 records; fixed before full reconstruction; no outcome selection

calendar.basis: observed May OHLC and user confirmation; bounded historical calendar, no holiday generalization

publication: F_LAST atomic; original source order; exact integer quote prices and nanosecond clocks
clock: provider receive as research availability; processing wall time is separately measured
ohlc: M1 midpoint from all committed MBO events; close-labelled; not trade OHLC or cTrader OHLC
parallelism: independent source-reset captures; one book owner per capture; native NumPy/Arrow kernels for feature materialization
history: raw source resets remain epoch boundaries, no invented cross-capture history
support: supported history and fresh origin are separate; current origin age budget 1s; book quote age budget 30s; no cross-gap or closed-session rolling windows

engineering_coverage_gate.scope: representation sufficiency; not predictive or economic admission

visual_selection: seed 20261015, one random admissible origin per reset capture, plus fixed break controls; no future-outcome filter
